reference_supported_mass: half of the recorded original TRON1 total native mass
contact_manifold_caveat: each native contact may contribute stiffness; nominal delta_ref is not claimed to equal observed wheel compression

bench.fixture_mass: fixed half-robot-equivalent vertical mass for all profiles
bench.extra_downward_load: zero from0to1s, m_ref*g from1to2s, zero from2to3s
bench.locked_axes: fixture XY translations and all rotations; Z is free
bench.live_material_switch: rigid arm only, after main trace: switch to3mm_d1 without advancing physics; if native readback confirms consumption, record another0.5s

robot_transfer: only after bench force/readback validation; original robot mass_COM_inertia, friction0.7, actor, references, raw actions and existing rewards retained
launch_constraints: freshly fully idle GPU3/5/4; one owned job at a time; no stopping other processes
